tips.text: Pop a Resource Booster before the whole farm; it doubles Rubedo, Cryotic and Salvage.
Finish the Salvage, Rubedo and Cryotic first, then get the Argon the day you build.
Bring Nekros with Desecrate to Survival or Defense to multiply Rubedo, Salvage and Argon drops.
The farm draws no complaints; the only chore is the volume of Salvage and Cryotic.
